verdict.rationale: Expensify documents some capabilities that act on many items. The Integration Server API can programmatically download expense report data and provision accounts. The AI assistant can create, categorize, tag, approve and reject expenses through plain-language requests. Workflow automation submits, approves and exports reports automatically. None of the evidence explicitly describes selecting many items and acting on them in one operation. Missing for 10: explicit documented bulk/batch operations (e.g. bulk approve, edit or export across selected items), bulk actions via the AI or API, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
